global: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with delicate toppings: chashu pork, menma, and naruto fish cake, artfully arranged. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it gleams under warm lighting against a dark wooden background.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and smooth texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior with a blue floral and vine pattern, featuring a smooth, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, with submerged noodles and floating green onions, showing gentle surface ripples.
regions.spoon: A pale green spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has browned, marbled texture with visible fat layers and slightly charred surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly curled, fibrous strips with visible texture and natural segmentation.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white with orange swirl, smooth surface, oval shape, slightly translucent, with visible spiral pattern.
